content:
The file Mathlib/Data/Nat/Digits/Lemmas.lean opens with public section but no expose. As a result, the definitions declared in this file are opaque when viewed from outside. Is this a bug or is it intentional?

If it is intentional, then what is the recommended way to prove lemmas about these definitions in another file? Should I add a lemma to unfold them?
I have no opinion about this specific file, but adding an API lemma is usually a good idea.
#39752 (I added an API lemma for the only definition that might be useful elsewhere)
